umapyoi.blessing.calm.effect.1: Chance to lose motivation when hurt -30%%. No panicking
umapyoi.blessing.calm.effect.2: Chance to lose motivation when hurt -60%%. No panicking
umapyoi.blessing.calm.effect.3: Getting hurt never lowers motivation. No panicking
umapyoi.blessing.calm.flavor: For a moment it seemed you could hear nothing at all, but that was all.
umapyoi.blessing.focus.effect.1: Career training points x1.05 (three-year career only)
umapyoi.blessing.focus.effect.2: Career training points x1.10 (three-year career only)
umapyoi.blessing.focus.effect.3: Career training points x1.15 (three-year career only)
umapyoi.blessing.focus.flavor: History pushes history forward, so the Umamusume of a new era may once again reach the summit of their time. That urge seems to be felt right now.
umapyoi.blessing.gale.flavor: Today's storm is wilder than usual, but perhaps it is only the roar of the chase.
umapyoi.blessing.happiness.effect.1: Take no damage for 60 s: motivation +1
umapyoi.blessing.happiness.effect.2: Take no damage for 45 s: motivation +1
umapyoi.blessing.happiness.effect.3: Take no damage for 30 s: motivation +1
umapyoi.blessing.happiness.flavor: A strange gentleness and comfort wash over you, and you accept them.
umapyoi.blessing.message.need_soul: Only a player wearing an Umamusume soul can receive blessings.
umapyoi.blessing.message.too_many: You already have 2 blessings. You can still extend them.
umapyoi.blessing.renewal.flavor: Your life will go on forever, always protected.
umapyoi.blessing.slumber.effect.1: No Night Owl. Sleeping gives +1 more motivation
umapyoi.blessing.slumber.effect.2: No Night Owl. Sleeping gives +1 more motivation
umapyoi.blessing.slumber.effect.3: No Night Owl. Sleeping gives +2 more motivation
umapyoi.blessing.sorrow.effect.1: Dying with it: no stat loss. Each hit takes 60 s off
umapyoi.blessing.sorrow.effect.2: Dying with it: no stat or motivation loss. Each hit takes 60 s off
umapyoi.blessing.sorrow.effect.3: Stops one death (back to 1 health). Each hit takes 60 s off
umapyoi.blessing.sorrow.flavor: The goddess from the underworld weeps, yet in her weeping you sense a feeling that is hard to notice.
umapyoi.blessing.survival.flavor: A roar from the jungle makes you tremble all over, but the feeling does not seem to come from fear.
umapyoi.career.death: A setback in her career: stats lowered, motivation at its lowest.
umapyoi.career.death_blessed: The blessing of Sorrow protected you: no stats were lost.
